issues.summary: Customs broker Harbor Gate filed the import declaration for HBL MFCIM260013 / MBL HMLU260481 (container HMLU6383102) under HS 8482.99 instead of the historically used HS 8482.10 without prior written confirmation, causing a duty difference of about USD 380 and a complaint from Daehan Precision.

decisions.summary: Minseo Park decided to keep the filed HS code 8482.99 for HBL MFCIM260013 and not pursue an amendment.

Minseo Park recorded a non-conformance against Harbor Gate Customs Brokerage for filing the declaration without written confirmation of the HS code change, requiring written confirmation of any classification change before filing.

tasks.summary: Inform Soyeon Moon at Daehan Precision that HS 8482.99 is kept for HBL MFCIM260013 and no amendment will be pursued.
